definition.en: The Human Development Report is an annual publication by the United Nations Development Programme that measures global progress in human development using the Human Development Index.
definition.hi: The Human Development Report is an annual publication by the United Nations Development Programme that measures global progress in human development using the Human Development Index.

importanceInUpsc.en: The HDR is critical for UPSC GS-3 as it provides a multidimensional perspective on poverty, inequality, and social development beyond mere GDP growth. It is frequently cited in Mains answers regarding inclusive growth, social justice, and India's performance in global development indicators.
